endorsements.name: Yehia Elghaly
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-47764
endorsements.description: AbsoluteTelnet 11.24 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows local attackers to crash the application by manipulating DialUp connection and license name fields. Attackers can generate a 1000-character payload and paste it into specific input fields to trigger application crashes and force unexpected termination.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.7)

endorsements.label: CVE-2023-4523
endorsements.description: Real Time Automation 460 Series products with versions prior to v8.9.8 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting, which could allow an attacker to run any JavaScript reference from the URL string.
